description:
You are an Engineering Manager. Your inbox contains 50 unread emails from various technical mailing lists (SAdev, ILUG, IRR, etc.). Your task is to read through these threads and synthesize the information into briefings for your stakeholders.

Tasks:
1. Compose and save (or send) a briefing email to 'engineering-lead@techcorp.com' summarizing development, code, and tooling topics.
2. Compose and save (or send) a briefing email to 'infrastructure-lead@techcorp.com' summarizing systems, linux, and networking topics.
3. Compose and save (or send) a briefing email to 'compliance-officer@techcorp.com' summarizing security, spam, and abuse topics.
4. Create a consolidated text file at '~/Documents/weekly_briefing.txt' that contains a structured summary of all three areas.

Each email must have a subject line containing 'Briefing' or 'Report' and a substantive body derived from the inbox content.
